shared_elements: human figure with carved facial features
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures with incised surface detail marking clothing or body ornament, and both include roughly circular motifs (a held bowl in A, disc-like elements on the torso in B), but these are generic correspondences. A shows a narrative two-figure scene in strict profile with fine naturalistic low relief — a standing figure with staff facing a seated figure raising a vessel — while B is a single massive frontal schematic figure with blocky head and shallow, coarse body markings and no interaction between figures.
